messages:
claire_sales: Quick escalation  BetaGrid POC: demo operator sees mixed trace linking in Console and the Splunk export shows empty trace_id for ~30% of rows. They also hit transient 429s during a bulk-scan. Can we do a short swarm? :mag_right:

ben_se: on it. Do we have one raw request + forwarder log sample? Even a single example will tell if the header arrived at our ingress but was lost before export.

claire_sales: pasted from their ticket (redacted):
```
POST /v1/complete 200 OK
Headers: {
  Authorization: Bearer REDACTED,
  X-Trace-Id: bb3344cc,
  traceparent: 00-bb3344cc000000000000000000000001-01
}
Client logs:
[2026-04-08T15:07:11Z] WARN status=429 request=req-456 trace=bb3344cc
[2026-04-08T15:07:12Z] INFO forwarder: send-hec status=ok trace=
```

ben_se: thanks. I reproduced the pattern in our staging traces: some requests show the header, but when the event is handed to the export worker it passes through an intermediate serializer that can drop empty headers for batched payloads. Hypothesis: header propagation broken for batched forwarder path + our exporter only copies header when present on the top-level event. Two fixes: (A) ensure exporter always extracts trace id from incoming HTTP context and injects `metadata.trace_id` into every exported event, or (B) enable `preserve_trace_headers` on the Splunk drain so the customer's forwarder includes headers in payload.

nora_sre: I can run quick checks: 1) scan export pipeline logs for events missing metadata.trace_id for org=betagrid, 2) check Splunk connector sampling rules, 3) temporarily increase POC token qps to reduce 429s for the demo. Need approval for short window.

claire_sales: I can approve a 20-minute bump for the demo. They are on a public demo in 40 minutes.

nora_sre: done  bumped token qps to 7rps for org=betagrid for 20m and turned on detailed export trace logging. Also flagged all export workers to log `trace_extracted=true/false`.

deploy-bot: runtime update queued: poc-qps-bump -> org-betagrid (owner: nora_sre). Canary: 3% traffic.
deploy-bot: canary OK. change rolled to 100% for org-betagrid.

ben_se: small code change I want to push to ensure robust propagation: exporter now sets `metadata.trace_id` from whichever source is available (in order): request-context trace header, X-Trace-Id, traceparent (extract trace id). It will also annotate exported events with `exporter.source=ingress` when it derived the value. Deploying to p-prod-canary. ETA ~6min.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: exporter-force-trace v2.0.0 -> p-prod-canary (owner: ben_se)
deploy-bot: canary health: 10/10 checks passed, 2% traffic routed.

ben_se: canary verified: exported events now contain metadata.trace_id=bb3344cc and exporter.source=ingress for those requests; Splunk HEC rows show matching ids. Observed a drop in missing-ids in debug logs from ~32% -> ~1% on the canary subset.

claire_sales: Awesome. What temporary config should I send to the customer while we roll this?

nora_sre: send this short runbook to ops:
1) Prefer `preserve_trace_headers` on intermediate forwarders. If the forwarder cannot preserve headers, add the trace id into event-level metadata (key `metadata.trace_id`) before sending to the HEC.
2) When creating Splunk HEC drain, include `map_trace_id=metadata.trace_id` and enable TLS + HEC token auth. Example curl to create drain:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/drains \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <org-token>" \
  -d '{"type":"splunk_hec","url":"https://splunk.betagrid:8088/services/collector","token":"HEC_TOKEN","map_trace_id":"metadata.trace_id","preserve_trace_headers":true}'
```
3) If a POC needs no sampling, request `trace_sampling: full` for the org (warning: increases export volume). For demos, we can also temporarily bump `token_qps` to avoid 429s.

keith_security: security checklist: confirm Splunk HEC endpoint uses TLS and that the HEC token scope is ingest-only. Also capture customer approval for the temporary qps bump in the security approvals log. I will add this to the security questionnaire entry for BetaGrid.

claire_sales: BetaGrid confirmed TLS + ingest-only HEC token and approved the 20m qps bump. I'll schedule a 10-min ops pairing call to walk through header passthrough + HEC config. Thanks everyone  saved the demo. :raised_hands:
